facts.text: Deborah took a photo of two women riding on a motorcycle on a dirt road last summer during a hike with Karlie, which was their last photo together.

evidence.quote: This is the last photo with Karlie which was taken last summer when we hiked. It was our last one.
Every time I see it, I can't help but smile.

facts.text: Deborah traveled to Bali last year, which she described as a gorgeous island that provided her with peace and was great for yoga.

evidence.quote: I've been blessed to travel to a few places and Bali last year was one of my favs. It was a gorgeous island that gave me peace, great for yoga.
